name: Proboscis!
summary:
Proboscis is a social VR movement game built around expressive locomotion, simple parkour, and hanging out with friends. Move through the world using hand‑based movement that feels fast, smooth, and intuitive. Explore multiple maps at your own pace, including a dedicated parkour section and the snowy Mountains area, each offering space to climb, jump, and discover new spots.
